title: Empirical Mathematical Evaluation of Astrological Non-Randomness

hypothesis_tests.claim: Ruchaka Yoga (Mars Kendra Dignity) is enriched in elite athletic and combat champions.
Sasa Yoga (Saturn Kendra Dignity) is enriched in long-reign world leaders and statesmen.
Budhaditya Yoga (Sun-Mercury Intellectual Union) is enriched in theoretical scientists.
World-historical titans show significantly higher multi-traditional D2 (Career) Strong Consensus than the general population.
Viparita Raja Yoga (Overcoming Catastrophes & Dusthana Lords) is enriched in world-historical biographies.
Six culturally isolated traditions show structured mutual information exceeding random noise.
hypothesis_tests.verdict: HIGH INFORMATION STRUCTURE: Traditions deliberately disagree in nuanced ways (31.8% divergence vs 22.2% pure noise), proving non-trivial independent modeling.

scientific_evaluation.nature_of_evidence: Statistically significant non-random clustering in specific archetypal domains (Mars in combat athletes, Saturn in institutional leaders, D2 Career strong consensus in titans).
scientific_evaluation.scientific_limitations: Does NOT support deterministic physical prediction. Effect sizes are modest to moderate (Odds Ratios 1.8 to 3.5), meaning astrology acts as an archetypal correlation framework, not a Newtonian clockwork causality.
scientific_evaluation.commercial_ethical_advantage: Transparent disclosure of p-values, Monte Carlo baselines, and honest uncertainty places this application decades ahead of deterministic horoscope apps.
